title: leontodon taraxacum var. scorzonera
intro: Leontodon taraxacum var. scorzonera, commonly known as Scorzonera, is a type of plant in the sunflower family, characterized by its edible roots and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Scorzonera include its ability to act as a diuretic and a laxative, helping to alleviate digestive issues such as constipation and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Scorzonera include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Scorzonera include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
